  • Class
    Description
    SwerveConstants
    Top-level, builder-style configuration for a swerve drivetrain: physical chassis dimensions, speed and acceleration limits, module/motor configuration, gyro selection, simulation-only parameters, and miscellaneous options, grouped into nested holder classes.
    SwerveConstants.Chassis
    Physical dimensions of the chassis and the kinematics derived from them.
    SwerveConstants.Gyro
    Which gyro hardware to build (via frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve.gyro.Gyro) and how to configure it.
    SwerveConstants.Gyro.GyroType
    Supported gyro hardware types.
    SwerveConstants.Modules
    Configuration shared by all swerve modules: motor types/constants and per-module hardware IDs.
    SwerveConstants.Simulation
    Parameters used only by the physics simulation (motor models and module gearbox identity); ignored on a real robot.
    SwerveConstants.Simulation.SwerveType
    Supported swerve module gearbox families (WCP/SDS MK4 variants).
    SwerveConstants.Special
    Less commonly changed options: odometry threading, PathPlanner robot config, starting pose, CAN bus, and auto-lock.
    SwerveConstants.Speeds
    Physical speed/acceleration capabilities of the swerve and the soft limits enforced on them.
    SwerveControllerConstants
    Configuration for a higher-level swerve auto-driving controller (e.g.
    SwerveModuleConstants
    Per-module hardware configuration for a single swerve module (motor CAN IDs, inversions and CANCoder calibration), consumed by SwerveModuleIOReal and SwerveModuleIOSim.
